title: Risk Prediction in Patients With Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction Using Gene Expression Data and Machine Learning
summary: Machine-learning models using gene-expression data stratified HFpEF patients by risk and predicted outcomes in held-out data; this is an exploratory cohort-specific profile. Reported comparison, experimental confirmation or held-out evaluation was checked; reason limits interpretation to the evidence.
